defects.claim: Calling stop inside onTick on the RAF path doesn't stop the loop: another frame gets queued after the callback returns
defects.scenario: A RAF-driven simulation whose onTick calls stop while alpha is still above the settle threshold: the stop cancels the outstanding request, then the callback returns and queues another frame, so the simulation keeps running
defects.cause: the RAF path doesn't check the running flag after onTick

defects.claim: setForces installs the replacement forces before initializing them, so a throwing initializer leaves uninitialized forces running on later ticks, and a retry skips their initialization
defects.scenario: A force initializer throws during setForces: later ticks still run the partial replacement, uninitialized forces included, and retrying with the same force objects skips initialization because they are already installed
defects.cause: the list is stored before initialization runs
